problem: Long video or full-runtime proofs are wasteful for localized visual defects.
invariant: Capture a bounded low-cost scout, retain exact-revision spatial/time identity, and select a bounded context window without silently moving the viewpoint. Use one prepared runtime and independently verify every emitted frame. Reduced diagnostic evidence must never mint full-proof or performance success.
evidence: YACS Issue #293: planner, asynchronous capture and evidence-validation contracts; native proof required
failure_behavior: Missing or stale frames, wrong SHA, unknown source or media failure remains explicit. No detected suspect is not visual acceptance.
